	, DEDUP_START_DATE AS SCD_START_DATE

(

			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) DEDUP_END_DATE

		FROM BUSC.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE

	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1

LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
ON CAST(DEDUP_END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;
